correctness.rationale: PASS: Resistance to two pinned vertices in a tree is h+z(ell-z)/ell, where h is pendant resistance and z is distance on the grounded path of total ell. Directly recomputed the eight symmetry-type grounded trace formulas from original RESULT.md (blob 20519d3fbfd07a0550ad1d942d0b8739904df3af): hubs 0 excess, own-hub+leaf t(q+1)-1 or t(p+1)-1, cross-hub+leaf [t(q-1)-1]/(t+1) or [t(p-1)-1]/(t+1), two leaves same side [N-4+2t(other side+1)]/2, opposite leaves [N-4+t(N-2)]/(t+2). Leaf-pair excesses strictly positive; own-hub options are worse than cross-hub options by t[1+(q+1)t]/(t+1) or its twin; compare remaining cross terms and zero to get stated threshold and tie/equal-side cases. Independently inverted rational grounded Laplacians and tested 690 pair/parameter combinations spanning 25 positive rational (p,q,t) instances (independent_extra.py: DOUBLE_STAR_OK), not extrapolated from finite checks.
